verdict.rationale: TaxJar is a developer-facing SaaS API, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. A direct probe of https://developers.taxjar.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack shows docs designed for agent consumption; standard human-readable API reference pages and SDKs do not count as agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
